claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., internal wear, cracked block, seized components).
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the engine running, or a detailed inspection of the cylinder head, crankshaft, and internal components.

risks.risk: The engine may not be from a compatible vehicle (e.g., wrong model, year, or make).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or a VIN tag, or a photo of the engine installed in a vehicle.

risks.risk: The engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number and any accident marks.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the engine block showing casting numbers or serial number.
A video or photo of the engine running or being tested.
A photo of the vehicle it was removed from, or a VIN plate.
Photos of other spare parts being sold, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
